question: My attacking 4/3 creature (no trample) is blocked by two creatures: a 2/3 and a 1/1. Do I have to assign damage to kill the first blocker before I can put any damage on the second, or can I split the 4 damage however I want between the two?
workedSolution: An attacking Elvish Regrower (a 4/3 creature) is blocked by Vampire Spawn (a 2/3 creature) and Helpful Hunter (a 1/1 creature). Elvish Regrower’s controller can assign all 4 damage to the Hunter, 1 damage to the Spawn and 3 damage to the Hunter, 2 damage to each creature, 3 damage to the Spawn and 1 damage to the Hunter, or all 4 damage to the Spawn.

whyHard: Players confuse this with the trample rule, which does force lethal-damage-first ordering against each blocker before excess can go elsewhere. A non-trampling attacker blocked by multiple creatures has no such requirement at all -- its controller may divide its damage among the blockers in any way, including leaving one blocker completely undamaged.
